# `unclassified-change`

The shape changed but no rule matched

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `warn` |
| **Rule IDs** | `unclassified-change` |
| **Status** | Planned (M4) |
| **Group** | Core variance rules (fallbacks) ([RULES.md section 1](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

Safety net: a node's shape hash changed, but no rule produced a finding for it.

## Why this default

The change might matter, and no rule has decided it doesn't. Every occurrence points at a missing rule.

## Example

_No example yet: one is added with the rule's test case when the rule is implemented._

## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file. The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  unclassified-change: warn
```

## How to fix

Check the change by hand. If it is safe, acknowledge the finding; either way, report it so a rule can be added.
